lines.text: Many learners say: How much people are in your class?
Better: How many people are in your class?
Many! How many students are here?

data.wrong: How much people are in your class?
data.right: How many people are in your class?

native.tip: 中文的“多少”什么都能问，所以容易说 how much people。人可以一个一个数，要用 how many。
native.caption: 你是不是也会说 “How much people are in your class?”😅 中文的“多少”通用，但人可以数，英语要用 how many：“How many people are in your class?”跟着 Ama 老师读一读！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。
native.comment: 答案：“How many people are in your class?”大声读一遍，再写一句你自己的句子。免费测验在这里：{link}

en.tip: Chinese uses one word for how much and how many. English splits them.
en.caption: Do you say “How much people are in your class?” 😅 English splits how much and how many, and people take many: “How many people are in your class?” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
